metadata.description: Function-hook mods for Claude Code: context gauge, live spinner, PR watcher, house style

plugins.name: context-watch
plugins.description: Context fill, cost and rate limits in the status line; threshold toasts; compaction that keeps edited files; /ctx pane

plugins.name: live-spinner
plugins.description: Spinner says what is actually running

plugins.name: pr-watch
plugins.description: Tracks PRs the session touches, shows checks above the prompt, toasts on green/red/merged

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: /handoff saves a state note, clears, and carries the note into the fresh context

plugins.name: agent-jobs
plugins.description: /jobs pane: running subagents and background shells with elapsed time and Stop

plugins.name: zsh-safe
plugins.description: Quotes glob flags zsh would expand (--include=*.ts) and keeps a grep that finds nothing from failing the command

plugins.name: pm-guard
plugins.description: Steers npm/npx/yarn to the package manager the repo's lockfile names (bun or pnpm), bun where there is none

plugins.name: remote-guard
plugins.description: Asks before a destructive command runs on another machine over ssh (restarts, deletes, kills, reboots)

plugins.name: xcode-status
plugins.description: In Xcode projects only: one line with the last build and test result and the booted simulator; flags 0-test runs; blocks a second xcodebuild while one runs

plugins.name: worktrees
plugins.description: /worktrees pane: each git worktree with branch, uncommitted changes, ahead/behind and PR state; removes clean worktrees whose PR is merged or closed

plugins.name: pr-rules
plugins.description: Blocks gh pr create / gt submit when a repo with an [Unreleased] changelog has no entry on the branch, and (where the repo asks for it) when the PR carries no labels

plugins.name: agent-models
plugins.description: Pins the model each subagent type runs on, set in /config or with /agent-models
